6972-8250-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6972-8250-8329--225.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.
6972-8250-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

1722-2034-3583-7492.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-7492.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

2034-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-7936--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur, adding {C}{C}.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7728.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-4247-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

280-5256-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

2457-4289-4927-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2573-3946-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6719-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6719-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1651-3715-5365-7741.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-7741.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

710-6797-7424.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2445-5147-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Branching Evolution.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Branching Evolution.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa, adding {C}{C}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Greenwarden of Murasa ability from step 2, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-6556.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-4518-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Kor Skyfisher using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-4518-6972.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4518-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

586-1472-4050-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-4050-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1753-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

132-1995-3053.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
132-1995-3053.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {3}{W}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3512-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3512-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3512-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

277-5412-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-5412-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1477-5394-6291.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

560-3394-4050-4550.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3394-4050-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding two mana of any color.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

3182-3676-4772-5751--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3182-3676-4772-5751--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature and sacrificing the two Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

509-1267-4639-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-4639-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

745-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Mirrorhall Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
745-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Mirrorhall Mimic
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

144-628-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 5, creating two Blood tokens.
Repeat.

372-1922-4863.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-4863.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Orzhov Basilica.
Repeat.
74-943-3861.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Orzhov Basilica instead.

654-1409-5868.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Frost Fair Lure Fish.
654-1409-5868.description:
Activate Frost Fair Lure Fish by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soullbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Frost Fair Lure Fish.
Resolve the Frost Fair Lure Fish trigger, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure tokens enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

360-661-5118.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
360-661-5118.notablePrerequisites:
Rescue Racer.
Ratchet is your commander.
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
360-661-5118.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Ratchet, Rescue Racer.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Sculpting Steel triggers, failing to convert it.
Cast Ratchet from the command zone as Ratchet, Field Medic by paying {2}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain one life.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, converting itself.
Put Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
Ratchet, Field Medic triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6.

215-1494-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {7}{G}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Sage of Hours with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altered Ego by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Altered Ego to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1765-2558-2899-3698.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station and Chishiro's first ability.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token that enters as a 1/1 due to Kaervek.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

261-1136-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
261-1136-1636.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, causing Phelddagrif to gain trample until end of turn and causing target opponent to create a 11 Hippo creature token.
The Hippo enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Suture Priest's second ability.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing the Hippo token's controller to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3305-4681-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2816-4747.notablePrerequisites: Alena does not have summoning sickness. You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
2816-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Alena by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3430-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
3430-3542.description:
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands you control that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6} and six {U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
